chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hasan ibn al-Walid, from Sufyan ibn al-Hayy, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from al-Husayn ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from his father, from his grandfather, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said: I asked him about a man who had a slave-girl and he freed her and she was pregnant, and he married her. He said: If he freed her and she was pregnant, and he married her, then her mahr is like the mahr of her equals, and if he divorced her before consummation, then her mahr is half of the mahr of her equals, and if he divorced her after consummation, then her mahr is the full mahr of her equals. And if he freed her and she was not pregnant, and he married her, then her mahr is like the mahr of her equals, and if he divorced her before consummation, then her mahr is half of the mahr of her equals, and if he divorced her after consummation, then her mahr is the full mahr of her equals. And if he freed her and she was pregnant, and he did not marry her, then her mahr is like the mahr of her equals, and if he divorced her before consummation, then her mahr is half of the mahr of her equals, and if he divorced her after consummation, then her mahr is the full mahr of her equals. And if he freed her and she was not pregnant, and he did not marry her, then her mahr is like the mahr of her equals, and if he divorced her before consummation, then her mahr is half of the mahr of her equals, and if he divorced her after consummation, then her mahr is the full mahr of her equals.
Wahrlich, zu den Rechten des Muslim gegenüber dem anderen Muslim gehört, dass er ihn beantwortet, wenn er ihn einlädt.
ai.seo_question: Was ist das Recht eines Muslim auf einen anderen Muslim in Bezug auf Einladungen?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi aufgezeichnet, unterstreicht diese Hadith von Imam al-Sadiq (AS) die gemeinschaftliche Pflicht, Einladungen anzunehmen, und stärkt die sozialen Bindungen und die gegenseitige Fürsorge innerhalb der Ummah. Sie spiegelt die breitere schiitische Betonung von Adab (Etikette) und den Rechten der Nachbarn und Verwandten wider und dient als praktischer Mechanismus zur Aufrechterhaltung der Einheit und zur Verhinderung der Entfremdung unter den Gläubigen.
